text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Fest—a huge
event
wherein Tracen Academy opens its
doors to fans
of all ages. This year,
however...

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Mommy, do you think I'll get to see
Oguri up
close?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text: Oh, don't you worry! It is very crowded, but I'm sure we'll get to see Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what? Oguri's event isn't until
later? So I
rushed out the door for
nothing... Still, I just can't
wait!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text: Man, it sure is packed, though. Is everyone here to see Oguri? She's so ridiculously popular.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The event is flooded with Oguri Cap
fans, eager
to get a glimpse of her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere of the Fan Fest is truly
amazing. I
suppose that's Oguri for you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing all these jubilant fans so
excited to meet
Oguri has made me
wonder.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
How exactly... should I be interacting
with fans?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I've always focused on claiming victory
over my
rivals and giving each race
everything I have so
that people might
remember the me of that
moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My own light shines ever brighter as I
garner more
and more experience
competing against my
precious rivals,
and that light has formed an
irrefutable
trail behind me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
With all the focus I've directed
elsewhere,
though, I think it could be
said that I haven't
devoted much
attention to fans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I have poured my heart and
soul into
my winning concerts, to express
my gratitude to
the fans who come to
watch my races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But then, as an Umamusume who lives to
race,
that's but a matter of course. Was
there more I
could have done for them?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I can't help but wonder.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...You see, I'm actually scheduled to
participate in
an event with Oguri later
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The notion of racing against her doesn't
frighten
me at all. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The thought of facing so many fans, and

entertaining them alongside her... Well,
that's a
different matter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm unsure as to how to approach the
event, and I
must admit it's making me
somewhat anxious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh?
choice_data_list: レースのように臨めばいいんじゃないか
レースのように臨めばいいんじゃないかな
choice_data_list_en: Why not approach it just like a race?
Maybe you could approach it just like a race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan puts everything she has
into each
race, and I think that devotion
is exactly what her
fans are dazzled by.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she commits herself to this Fan Fest
event in the
same way she commits to
her races, then her fans
will get exactly
what they came here to see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Are you certain?
choice_data_list: 君が全力で臨めば、きっとファンも喜ぶよ
貴方が全力で臨めば、きっとファンも喜ぶよ
choice_data_list_en: If you give it your all, your fans will surely be thrilled.
If you give it your all, I'm sure the fans will be happy too

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: ファンをぶんどる勢いでいこう
choice_data_list_en: Let's go out there and steal all their fans!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe! Your choice of words is as
entertaining as
ever, Trainer... and
reassuring, too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The wait is over! Our next "Improv Race"
will be
betweeeen...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap and Mejiro Ardan! Come
ooon
dowwwn!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I look forward to our competition.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Same. Good luck.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Same as always, after we give our

contestants some prompts, they'll have
to come
up with the funniest answer
they possibly can, and
then it'll be up to
you, the fans, to decide the
winner!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Your hosts will be me—Super
Creek—and
Tamtam, whom you know as
Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Da heck is this lineup, though?! These gals are so oblivious, they can't even catch jokes, let alone make 'em! I'm gonna turn into a skeleton waitin'!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Aw, but Oguri and Ardan are such
honest and
innocent little cuties. It
warms my heart just
looking at them!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
See?! This is exactly what I mean! Creek
doesn't
even realize she's one of the
airheads!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama really is something. She can
entertain
everyone so effortlessly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Improv Q&A... While I've never done anything like this before, it is a battle of wits involving rapid wordplay... so it's not entirely different from racing!)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's get this started with the first
prompt!
"Tamtam nearly tripped over her
own feet rushing
out the dorm this
morning. Why?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, why's da prompt about me?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (That was so fast!)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oguri's first up! Okay, what's your
answer?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
To be first in line for the cafeteria's
limited-time
special, eggs-travagant
eggs benedict!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You did that yesterday! YOU !

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I refuse to lose!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You're up, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Tamamo is a straight-laced hard worker
and I
expect her roommate relies on her
for certain
things. As such...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To retrieve breakfast from the cafeteria
for
Oguri, who overslept!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think I am, Oguri's lackey? Her
mom?!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It looks like you've both tickled tons of
funny
bones! This should be a close
match!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Nice one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I have every intention of putting up a
fight.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh no. These idiots are actually gonna do the whole routine. We're cooked, guys...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A dead heat (of sorts) rages on between
Mejiro
Ardan and Oguri Cap...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: All right, the votes are in!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I made so many quips... I'm losin'
my...
voice...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And the winner is...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oguri, by a hair!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Argh!

text_block_list.name: Male Ardan Fan
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardaaan!

text_block_list.name: Male Ardan Fan
text_block_list.text:
You were so close! But you were really
hilarious!
Nice job out there!

text_block_list.name: Female Ardan Fan
text_block_list.text: I never get to see this side of you at the track! It's soooo cute! I hope you do this again someday!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(What a relief... It appears the fans
enjoyed
themselves!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It looks like both our fans had a good
time. That's
good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes... It is indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's have another contest for the fans
sometime.
We could do improv again...
or take it to the
track!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sure!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The competitors are shaking hands!
What a
beautiful sight!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Know what? Someone else come take da
mic. I
give up...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ardan, by a hair!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...?! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Male Ardan Fan
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardaaan!

text_block_list.name: Male Ardan Fan
text_block_list.text: You were hilarious! Do this again, okay?! I'll be first in line to get tickets!

text_block_list.name: Female Ardan Fan
text_block_list.text: I never get to see this side of you at the track! It's soooo cute!

text_block_list.name: Ardan Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ardan! Mejiro Ardan!
Miss Ardan!

Ardaaan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Have I... always had this many fans?!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It looks like both our fans had a good
time. That's
good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes... It is indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's have another contest for the fans
sometime.
We could do improv again...
or take it to the
track!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's. And next time, I shan't lose!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The competitors are shaking hands!
What a
beautiful sight!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Know what? Someone else come take da
mic. I
give up...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's event ends on a high
note, but
elsewhere, at this very
moment...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've been away for so long, and yet so all
these
people have come to see me? I... I
don't know
what to say!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I hear you have a major
announcement
to make. Whatever could
it be?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I, Sakura Chiyono O... plan to return to
racing at
this year's Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm currently working as hard as I can on
my final
preparations! I really hope you'll
all look forward
to my comeback with
bated breath!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My name is Sakura Chiyono O... and I
will
blossom on the turf once more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With word of Sakura Chiyono O's return

spreading like wildfire, everyone's
suddenly
talking about the Takarazuka
Kinen!
